answer: Reaching eligibility takes 79 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The pulse register is checked at draw time, lantern lists the eligible set, and velvet seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 79 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. A farm of 254 pays that 260 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
